posts.name: ABHISHEK KUMAR
posts.cooked:
I attempted three questions in the System Commands OPE, but in the results, I have received only 23 marks. Some others attempted only two questions and still scored above 40. Please look into this matter.

Also, during the OPE, the virtual machine was not working properly. After solving one question, I had to reopen PowerShell and log in again, and the VM was freezing for about 5 minutes at a time. Considering these issues, I request you to review my case since I attempted three questions but was awarded only 23 marks.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Only your first question is solved correctly, which has awarded you 20 marks.

Third question has a private test case expecting empty output, this is the only test case your code passes since it has syntax error and fails on all test cases.

Giving you \frac{1}{7}\times20 for a total of 22.8 marks.

Your second solution does not work, and throws errors, which obviously will fetch you zero marks.
